I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of the Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The land described as Lot No. A with the extent of 0.0126 Hect. mentioned in the progression tracing bearing No. B/ACQ/BDL/2017/116 and dated 30.09.2017 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in Sumanathissagama (Division Number 11) (within Badulla Municipality) coming under 78 B Badulla East Grama Niladhari Division in the minor division of Rilpola Korale of Badulla Divisional Secretary Division in Badulla District in the Province of Uva.

1. Lot ‘A ’ – Sumanathissagama - Extent : 0.0126 Hectares North: Sumanathissagama land possessed by Shriyani Dewapura and cement drain; East: Cement drain and Sumanathissagama land claimed by Muthiyangana Rajamaha Viharaya; South: Sumanathissagama land claimed by Muthiyangana Rajamaha Viharaya and road; West: Sumanathissagama land claimed by Muthiyangana Rajamaha Viharaya, road and Sumanathissagama land claimed by Shriyani Dewapura.
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My Reference No.: 4-3/4/2016/WS/516.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,“Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla.05 th October, 2022.
